//: Antigravity CLI (agy) — symlinked to ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json via dotbot, BUT agy replaces that symlink with a plain normalized copy on every run (verified 2026-08-14). This repo file stays source of truth: after editing it, relink (./install); before relinking, merge any live-file additions (trust entries, UI prefs) back here. Replaces the retired Gemini CLI (dead since 2026-06-18).
//model: Exact label from `agy models` (1.1.25). Gemini 3.8 Flash GA 2026-09-02, effort baked into the label. HIGH is a deliberate OPT-UP, not the vendor default: Google ships 3.8 Flash at medium and recommends medium for complex code/agentic work, with high to maximize reasoning and tool orchestration at more tokens and latency (~3 pts on DeepSWE v1.1, 74 vs 71). Clemens ruling 2026-09-03: agy is the research/grounding seat and deeper reasoning is worth the tokens here. Drop to medium with `agy --effort medium` (flag takes low|medium|high) if latency or quota bites.
//telemetry: Default is enableTelemetry=true and docs say interaction logs are shared to improve Antigravity/models — opt out explicitly. Keep these false before the NEXT authenticated run: CLI logs only show propagation is skipped while logged out, so the remote opt-out is unverified until re-auth. Opt-out is not retroactive — past Interactions need a deletion request to antigravity-support@google.com.
//toolPermission: always-proceed = yolo (no permission prompts), matches codex approval_policy=never / claude bypassPermissions. Other values: request-review (default), proceed-in-sandbox, strict. Verified via cli.log 'CLI settings initialized: toolPermission=...'.
//trustedWorkspaces: Suppresses the 'do you trust this folder' prompt. WSL paths (/home) and macOS paths (/Users) both listed on purpose — this file is shared across both machines and an unknown path re-prompts.
